component.name: MoldWeaver
component.summary: Generate 3D-printable mold boxes for silicone casting

description.p: MoldWeaver turns a 3D model into 3D-printable mold boxes for silicone casting. Load a model, place the parting plane (or let MoldWeaver suggest one), tune the settings and export a single 3MF with every mold part laid out on your printer's plate.

ul.li: Two-part split box with a printed parting board, so you can pour both silicone halves without clay
Open tray (one-part) molds for flat-backed models
Undercut highlighting and automatic parting plane suggestions
Pour spout, air vents, registration keys, bolt flanges, zip-tie slots and printed clamps
Silicone volume, weight and cost estimate per pour
Exports 3MF that opens in Bambu Studio and OrcaSlicer

description.p: First release: two-part split box and open tray molds, plane suggestions, 3MF export.
